_comment: Tests skipped on every CI lane on purpose, each with why CI cannot run it there (tools/ci/skip_ledger.py). Keep it small: a test that can run on a lane belongs on that lane.

entries.reason: it is the skip: it proves skip_unless_db_feature skips a feature no database has
runs only while the catalogue has a planned code; today every code has landed
needs promtool, which the test jobs do not install; deploy-profiles runs the same rules through deploy/observability/check.sh
opt-in (SANDLOOM_SPLIT_E2E): the app-split job runs the split scenario
opt-in (SANDLOOM_RECIPES_E2E): the app-recipes job runs the recipes
opt-in (SANDLOOM_EXTRACTION_E2E): the extraction-e2e workflow runs it
opt-in: `sandloom dev` against a developer's own PostgreSQL and Redis named in SANDLOOM_TEST_DATABASE_URL / SANDLOOM_TEST_CACHE_URL; the CI lanes provide their services without those variables

slow, and it needs SANDLOOM_QUICKSTART_POSTGRES_URL, which no test lane sets: the quickstart jobs run the same scenario through tools/smoke/quickstart_check.py (PR CI deselects it with -m "not slow"; release validation runs slow tests)
